lines: RAMESH RADHAKRISHNAN, role unknown, is selling 80,000 shares in the offer for sale, bringing in proceeds.
Proceeds of ₹5.60 crore are scheduled for On or about Friday, October 23, 2026, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Employee-portion shares sold at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower than ₹5.60 crore.
Caveat: average cost of acquisition and pre-offer holding are not confirmed from the documents.
